Documents of other kinds (source "url") are fetched from a pinned URL: committed under docs/ when their license allows it (redistribute: true), otherwise only the URL is kept and the text goes to the git-ignored .cache/. A source that is not Markdown or plain text names its "format" ("wikitext" or "html") and is stored converted to Markdown.
